boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Named Academy settings for studying, meals, training, worship, athletics, and waterfront activity; access is governed by Academy procedures.

cards.title: Bland Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: Library meeting space on the Kings Point campus
cards.notes: Use the library as a named academic stop and confirm entry rules with Academy staff; the Crabtree Room has hosted Academy meetings.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with documented meeting-room use.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA reported that its Congressional Board of Visitors meeting was held in the Crabtree Room of Bland Memorial Library.
cards.source_title: United States Merchant Marine Academy Hosts Congressional Board of Visitors
cards.access_notes: Campus access and library use may be controlled; verify current visitor procedures before arrival.

cards.title: Delano Hall
cards.subtitle: Historic dining hall for the Regiment of Midshipmen
cards.notes: Plan this as a meal-time landmark only if you are an authorized guest; it is the Academy’s documented dining setting for residential midshipmen.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA states that all meals are served in historic Delano Hall, which can host the entire regiment simultaneously.
cards.access_notes: Meals in Delano are available only to midshipmen and authorized guests.

cards.title: Seafarer Canteen
cards.subtitle: Deli-type café operated under Academy food services
cards.notes: Use the name when asking Academy staff about food-service options; purchase and access details should be confirmed before relying on it.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA’s Food Services page identifies the Seafarer canteen as a deli-type café overseen by the Food Service Officer.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current hours, eligibility, and payment arrangements with Academy food services.

cards.title: Topside Restaurant
cards.subtitle: Academy food-service venue
cards.notes: Treat this as a named food-service stop rather than an assumed public restaurant; ask Academy staff about current availability and entry procedures.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant named by the Academy’s food-services office.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA’s Food Services page says the Food Service Officer oversees operation of the Topside restaurant.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current service, access, and payment requirements directly with Academy food services.

cards.title: Yocum Waterfront Center
cards.subtitle: Boat-basin waterfront setting on campus
cards.notes: View the waterfront setting from approved areas and coordinate any water activity through Academy programs; do not assume public equipment access.
cards.short_summary: The Academy’s named boat-basin waterfront center.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA describes a boat basin and the Yocum Waterfront Center near the campus war memorial.
cards.access_notes: Waterfront and boating access may be program-controlled; follow Academy and waterfront safety directions.

cards.title: O’Hara Hall
cards.subtitle: Indoor athletics building
cards.notes: Coordinate fitness or pool use through Academy athletics and check eligibility first; the building contains multiple training and recreation areas.
cards.short_summary: An indoor athletics hub with gym and pool facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA lists O’Hara Hall’s gymnasium, Olympic-size pool and diving well, racquetball courts, wrestling room, and cardio, core, and weight-training areas.
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to Academy athletics and facility-access rules; verify current arrangements before visiting.

cards.title: Gibbs Hall
cards.subtitle: Science and engineering laboratory building
cards.notes: Use this as an academic waypoint and ask a department host before entering labs; the Academy identifies the building with science and engineering instruction.
cards.short_summary: A campus home for science and engineering laboratories.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA states that Gibbs Hall contains modern science and engineering laboratories.
cards.access_notes: Laboratory access is likely restricted to authorized students, staff, and supervised guests.

cards.title: Samuels Hall
cards.subtitle: Humanities and nautical-science teaching building
cards.notes: Ask the relevant department about tours or demonstrations; the building combines classrooms, computing resources, labs, and a ship’s bridge simulator.
cards.short_summary: A multidisciplinary teaching building with a bridge simulator.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA identifies Samuels Hall as containing Humanities classrooms, computer resources, a ship’s bridge simulator, and nautical-science teaching laboratories.
cards.access_notes: Classrooms, labs, and simulator access require Academy authorization; arrange any visit in advance.

cards.title: Mariners’ Memorial Chapel
cards.subtitle: Interfaith chapel on the grassy knoll south of the War Memorial
cards.notes: Use the chapel respectfully for approved services or quiet reflection, and check the Academy calendar or chaplaincy for current access.
cards.short_summary: An interfaith worship space serving the regiment.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA describes an interfaith chapel south of the War Memorial that serves the religious needs of the regiment.
cards.access_notes: Service and building access may vary; confirm current chapel arrangements with the Academy.

cards.entity_name: USMMA World War II War Memorial
cards.title: The World War II War Memorial
cards.subtitle: Campus monument overlooking the waterfront area
cards.notes: Pause to read the memorial in an approved outdoor area and keep the visit reflective; it anchors several nearby campus landmarks.
cards.short_summary: A memorial-centered landmark in the Academy’s waterfront campus landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA describes a monument to Academy World War II casualties, with the pool, boat basin, Yocum Waterfront Center, Gibbs Hall, and Samuels Hall grouped around it.
cards.access_notes: Observe from areas open to you and comply with campus security and memorial-site guidance.

warnings: USMMA is a federal service academy; access to campus buildings and waterfront facilities may be restricted. Verify current visitor procedures before travel.
